notes: E-Hub forms: the keyboard no longer covers what you type in Seller Center, your business account, enquiries and the enquiry form on a provider's page.
Business account: a category you typed is now saved when you tap Save, even if you didn't tap Add first.
Sharing an E-Hub product now sends just the link, so chats show the product's name, price and photo.
Fixes: long descriptions scroll inside their box so you can see what you're typing, image upload problems show a clear message, and the draft delete button reads "Delete draft".
